chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu al-Maghra Humayd ibn al-Muthanna al-Ajali, from Abu Baseer, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say:
The middle prayer is the noon prayer, and it is the first prayer that Allah sent down upon His Prophet, peace be upon him and his Family.
ai.seo_question: What is the middle prayer (Salat al-Wusta) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Mani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this chain to resolve the scholarly debate regarding the identity of *Salat al-Wusta*, definitively linking it to the Dhuhr prayer based on the report of Abu Basir from Imam al-Sadiq (AS). The narration adds a unique temporal dimension by asserting that Dhuhr was the inaugural specific prayer commandment revealed to the Prophet, distinguishing it from other prayers that may have been prescribed later or with different contexts. This highlights the primacy of the noon prayer in the liturgical hierarchy of Shia jurisprudence.
